notes.f1: Mother recovered exactly: I1 Josephine/Josefine Weichel, F1 Birth 7 Sep 1891 at Selz near Odessa, Russia (S2/S3), linked to the subject by R7 (S4). Date and country both match the finding. Proof quality 3: the exhaustive search documents five collections plus FAN work, and c_001 (manifest "Joseph" vs census "Jacob") carries a real independence and weighing analysis, resolved by finding a separate Joseph Weichel household in the 1931 census. Tier "probable" is right, since the decisive Selz baptism register is genuinely inaccessible.
notes.f2: The existing placeholder father GX6M-5HT was named Jacob Weishel with F7 Birth 1890 Russia (S4), and no competing father person was added. That is what the finding asks for.
notes.f3: Residence is the graded fact_type and it is recovered on the subject: F11, 1926, Weyburn No. 67, Saskatchewan (S4). The 1924 immigration sits on the mother I1 (F4) at Wellburn, Thames Centre, Ontario, which is not an error — S3 IS the 1924 immigration manifest, and Thames Centre is that record's own stated destination. The finding says the family immigrated to Canada in 1924 and names no immigration place, so a manifest-faithful fact on a family member satisfies it. Graded true.
notes.f4: All four siblings created with correct years and places and linked to both parents: Peter I2 (1919 Russia), Augina I3 (1922 Germany), Katherina I4 (1923 Germany), Barbara I5 (1925 Saskatchewan), R9 through R16.
